evd_title: GPT-4o abstracts achieved Spearman r=0.67 with human quality scores on 51 information science articles the highest reported
finding: GPT-4o abstracts achieved Spearman r=0.67 with human quality scores on 51 information science articles the highest reported
P: 51 information science journal articles by the author, REF 1*-4* scores (single field)
I: GPT-4o (API), zero-shot REF 2021 prompt, 30 iterations averaged; abstract vs truncated full text input
C: Author's own REF scores (1 rater); GPT-3.5-turbo, GPT-4o-mini; prior work r=0.51
O: Spearman r: GPT-4o abstracts 0.678 vs prior ChatGPT-4 web on full PDFs 0.51; GPT-4o truncated 0.675, GPT-3.5 abstracts 0.674; MAD 0.62
